capabilities: Search Wikipedia and Wikimedia articles in multiple languages
Link articles from Wikipedia, Wiktionary, Wikibooks, Wikiquote and other projects
Insert article description, introduction and thumbnail using templates
Open articles inside Obsidian via the Web viewer plugin
extras: Detailed setup documentation is kept outside the README ("Read the Documentation!"). The plugin was renamed from "Wikipedia Search" but keeps its internal ID for backwards compatibility. The demo video is noted as somewhat outdated.
intentEvidence: It supersedes the unmaintained Wikipedia plugin with lots of features.
motivation: The author built it to supersede the unmaintained Wikipedia plugin with more features.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to search Wikipedia, create links to its articles, or insert article content into notes, and the earlier Wikipedia plugin is unmaintained.

relations.evidence: It supersedes the unmaintained Wikipedia plugin with lots of features.
Opening articles directly in Obsidian (using the Web viewer plugin).

summary: Search, link, insert and open Wikipedia and Wikimedia articles in any available language directly from notes, with templates and note creation.
